_notes.V6_V7: Directives V6 (Zero False Claims) and V7 (Exact-read discipline) carry 'Level 2 (Extended) minimum' conformance notes in SPECIFICATION.md §3.2. Add them here with their enforcement entries only when claiming Extended; a Core manifest listing them violates the domain-bounded-levels honesty rule (§5).
_notes.check_P: Check P is the structural enforcement of V6 — include it in checks_implemented at Extended and above, alongside D, M, N, O.
_notes.check_Q: Check Q is the structural enforcement of Directive E5 (Decision rights) — include it in checks_implemented at Extended and above, alongside D, M, N, O and P. It is advisory where the agent lacks a durable action record.
_notes.V8_core: Directive V8 (Mechanical staging validation) carries a Level 1 (Core) minimum conformance note in SPECIFICATION.md §3.2 — include it in Core manifests when the agent stages deployable artifacts with an available validator; omit only for agents that stage nothing validated.
